test.title: Subtotal below $100.00 receives no spend discount

checks.why: 3 items of product 2 at $25.00 each sum to $75.00 subtotal
Orders below $100.00 receive no spend discount
Total equals subtotal of $75.00 minus $0.00 tier discount

test.title: Subtotal exactly $100.00 qualifies for 10% spend discount

checks.why: 4 items of product 2 at $25.00 each sum to $100.00 subtotal
Orders with a subtotal of $100.00 or more get 10% off ($100.00 * 0.10 = $10.00)
Total is subtotal $100.00 minus tier discount $10.00

test.title: Subtotal exceeding $100.00 applies 10% discount rounded half-up

checks.why: 3 items of product 1 at $39.90 each sum to $119.70 subtotal
10% discount on $119.70 subtotal is $11.97
Total is subtotal $119.70 minus tier discount $11.97

test.title: Updating cart quantity across $100 boundary dynamically applies tier discount and persists state

checks.why: 2 items of product 4 at $45.00 each sum to $90.00
Subtotal $90.00 is below $100.00, so tier discount is $0.00
3 items of product 4 at $45.00 each sum to $135.00
Subtotal increased above $100.00 triggers 10% tier discount of $13.50
Total updated to subtotal $135.00 minus tier discount $13.50
Persisted cart subtotal remains $135.00
Persisted cart tier discount remains $13.50
Persisted cart total remains $121.50

issues: step 4 subtotal: test expects '135.00', reviewer predicts '121.50' (The subtotal remains the same as the total before checkout, which is 121.50.)

step 4 total: test expects '121.50', reviewer predicts '108.00' (The total is calculated as subtotal - tier_discount - coupon_discount. Since no coupon is applied, the total is 121.50 - 13.50 = 108.00.)

test.title: Applying a second coupon fails with 409 COUPON_LIMIT and leaves cart unchanged

checks.why: 2 items of Glow Serum at 25.00 each equal a subtotal of 50.00
SAVE10 applies 10% discount on 50.00 subtotal which is 5.00
Applying a second coupon to a cart that already has one must fail with 409 COUPON_LIMIT
Cart remains unchanged after failed coupon addition attempt
Total is subtotal 50.00 minus coupon discount 5.00

issues: step 5 coupon_discount: test expects '5.00', reviewer predicts '0.00' (The 'LESS5' coupon was not applied, so the coupon discount remains $0.00.)
step 5 total: test expects '45.00', reviewer predicts '50.00' (The total is the subtotal minus the coupon discount, which is $50.00 - $0.00 = $50.00.)

test.title: Applying a second coupon with same code in lowercase fails with 409 COUPON_LIMIT

checks.why: 1 item of Wireless Earbuds at 39.90 equals subtotal of 39.90
LESS5 gives a fixed 5.00 discount
Coupons are case-insensitive so applying less5 when LESS5 exists counts as applying a second coupon
Cart coupon discount remains unchanged at 5.00

issues: step 2 subtotal: test expects '39.90', reviewer predicts '34.90' (The cart contains 1 item of Wireless Earbuds priced at $39.90 with a quantity of 1. Since the subtotal is $39.90, which is less than $100.00, no spend discount applies. The only discount applied is the 'LESS5' coupon, which reduces the subtotal by $5.00.)

test.title: Removing an applied coupon allows applying a new coupon

checks.why: 4 items of Glow Serum at 25.00 each equal subtotal of 100.00
LESS5 applies 5.00 discount
Removing coupon restores coupon discount to 0.00
After removing previous coupon cart has 0 coupons so SAVE10 can be applied successfully

test.title: Add item with maximum allowed quantity of 20

checks.why: Quantity of 20 is within the allowed range of 1 to 20.
Fetching cart verifies quantity 20 was persisted.

test.title: Add item with quantity 21 exceeding maximum limit

checks.why: Quantity 21 exceeds the maximum limit of 20 and must fail with QTY_RANGE.
Failed item add attempt must not modify cart items.

test.title: Add item with quantity 0 below minimum limit

checks.why: Quantity 0 is below the minimum limit of 1 and must fail with QTY_RANGE.

test.title: Add quantity to existing item causing cumulative quantity to exceed 20

checks.why: Initial addition of quantity 15 succeeds within allowed range.
Adding 6 to existing 15 brings total quantity to 21, exceeding limit of 20.
Failed addition must leave item quantity unchanged at 15.

issues: step 2 items.0.qty: test expects '15', reviewer predicts '21' (Initially, 15 units of product 1 are added to the cart. The second request adds 6 more units, so the total quantity for product 1 is 21.)

step 4 items.0.qty: test expects '15', reviewer predicts '21' (After the second request, the cart contains 21 units of product 1. The GET request to /api/carts/{cart} returns the current state of the cart, which includes the quantity of 21 for product 1.)

test.title: Checkout succeeds when item quantity exactly equals available stock

checks.why: Purchasing 3 units of product 5 with 3 available stock leaves 0 stock remaining.

test.title: Checkout fails with 409 OUT_OF_STOCK when item quantity exceeds available stock

checks.why: Quantity 4 exceeds available stock 3, so checkout fails with OUT_OF_STOCK.
Failed checkout must not change the stock of any product.

issues: step 4 [id=5].stock: test expects '3', reviewer predicts '0' (After the checkout, the stock of product_id 5 (Phone Tripod) is reduced by 4. The initial stock is 3, so the remaining stock is 3 - 4 = -1. However, stock cannot be negative, so the stock is set to 0.)

test.title: Multi-item checkout failure preserves stock for all products in cart

checks.why: Checkout fails because product 5 quantity exceeds available stock.
Stock of in-stock item 3 must remain unchanged after failed checkout.
Stock of out-of-stock item 5 must remain unchanged after failed checkout.

issues: step 4 HTTP status: test expects '409', reviewer predicts '{status: 200, products: [...]}' (The cart has a subtotal of $198.00 (2 * $59.00 + 4 * $19.50 = $118.00 + $80.00). Since the subtotal is above $100.00, a 10% discount is applied, reducing the subtotal to $178.20. The `LESS5` coupon is applied, further reducing the subtotal by $5.00 to $173.20. The total is $173.20. The checkout is successful, so the status code is 200.)

step 5 [id=3].stock: test expects '5', reviewer predicts '3' (After the checkout, the quantity of LED Ring Light (id=3) is reduced by 2. The initial stock was 5, and 2 were purchased, so the remaining stock is 3.)

step 5 [id=5].stock: test expects '3', reviewer predicts '0' (After the checkout, the quantity of Phone Tripod (id=5) is reduced by 4. The initial stock was 3, and 4 were purchased, so the stock is now 0.)
